softwarelist.name: trs80m2_hdd
softwarelist.description: Tandy TRS-80 Model II hard disk images

info.name: usage
info.value: Requires the hdi card. Boot lsdos631ds from floppy, then SYSTEM (DRIVE=2,DRIVER="TRSHD2") with drive select 1, 6 heads, 306 tracks, step rate 0, 4 heads for partition, starting head 1
